profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Skunk Works
profile.summary:
I love to build, problem-solve, and improve. 
I was a clumsy kid growing up and often broke my toys. However, those broken toys led me to my interest in how things worked. I get the most fulfillment in my life by building something new, or fixing something. I enjoy learning and continually improving my abilities and skills. I am currently working in the Aerospace/Defense Industry as a Systems Engineer for the Lockheed Martin Skunkworks. 

If you have any questions or job opportunities please feel free to contact me.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Supported Test Automation and Software Infrastructure on the F-35 program and on programs within the Skunk Works.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: RF & EO Engineer on Mission Systems within ADP (Skunk Works).

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Supported the development, deployment, and management of F-35 Test Systems to Government Depots.

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description: Worked as a technician on desktop FDM 3D printers. This involved performing maintenance, advising students, and generating gcode for the machines.

positions.title: College Intern (F-35 Test Systems)
positions.description: Summer Internship with F-35 Sustainment for F-35 Test Systems.

volunteerExperiences.description: Served as the co-leader of a camp within Impact, working to train counselors and adapt around the complications that COVID-19 brought to the camp.
